title: Longevypedia claim document
description: A scientific statement evaluated separately from the evidence. The claim block records the exact proposition and the current state of evidence; sources and relations record why.

statement.description: The proposition in one sentence, phrased so that it could be refuted. Not a summary of a paper.

confidence.description: How well the claim is supported overall. `established` is reserved for textbook-level consensus.

evidence_direction.description: Net direction of the evidence collected on this page.

scope.description: Where the claim applies: species, population, dose range, timeframe. A claim without scope is usually overstated.

as_of.description: Date the evidence assessment was last checked.
